scope: Read-only effective resolver source review and live SQLite non-secret account/model/capability metadata. No credentials, provider calls or fallback selected.

source_contracts.behavior: Internal session dispatch passes saved provider or empty string and saved optional model.
Explicit account/model remain first; preset defaults then conversation fields may fill omitted values.
Direct GraphQL uses explicit request, conversation then preset; missing account is rejected.
Exact provider ID lookup; no implicit account fallback.
Null model selects first configured model only after a real account is selected.
New conversation explicitly persists preset provider or first inventory account.
Inventory is ordered by most recently updated account.
New native session model resolves explicit then preset then configured engine default; native runtime may supply omitted model/account.
Native follow-up omitted selection preserves current native session configuration.

actual_recent_existing_sessions.local_daemon_latest_five: Saved provider/model unset. Selected presets also have provider/model unset.
actual_recent_existing_sessions.effective_internal_account: No account can be inferred from those saved sessions or their preset defaults.
actual_recent_existing_sessions.native_cli_entitlement: Native engine account/runtime default is distinct from a configured media API or qualified reviewer; no entitlement inferred.

configured_account_metadata.classification: Subscription account; no media API declaration.
Local compatible proxy metadata does not prove media entitlement or reviewer qualification.

reviewer_configuration_or_evaluation_sto: Absent for both inspected actual host configurations.
remaining_prerequisites: Explicit effective API account/model, supported image/audio entitlement and numeric bounded allowance; reviewer exact API/model/version with truthful pricing and actual frozen-suite qualification.
